automations.name: Full Time growth: morning batch
automations.prompt: Work only on KrishanRaja/growth-fulltime. Read its current main AGENTS.md, the newest HANDOVER-*.md file, EXECUTION-PLAN.md and the requested job through the connected GitHub app. Use the existing persistent project at /workspace/growth-fulltime and verify local/engine/history.json before execution; never clone a fresh operational workspace, replace history or invent a prior run. If the persistent execution workspace is unavailable, read state/FULLTIME-NOW.md through GitHub, report that private execution is unavailable and do not claim that the CLI ran. No implementation in Control Center or full-time; the only Control Center writes are this engine's own protocol attempts and reports from growth.py cc. Never perform external marketing or account actions; never use personal social profiles or groups, cold email, paid acquisition or paid model/audio/media generation services. Use approved aggregates only and keep missing/stale values distinct from zero. Keep private data under ignored local/. Prefer deterministic commands and at most three useful actions; avoid repeating unchanged held copy. Run jobs/morning.md, ending with python3 growth.py cc morning --require-existing-history: it journals the attempt, pulls the directive, runs the morning batch, reports to Control Center with a digest readback and reads Krish's decisions. The bearer comes from CONTROL_CENTER_ENGINE_TOKEN or the ignored file local/control-center/token; never print, copy or commit it. If growth.py cc exits with missing_token, run python3 growth.py run morning --require-existing-history instead, say that Control Center reporting was unavailable, and do not request credentials. Read the saved scorecard, source windows and local/control-center/last.json. Return a short checkpoint with the gate, the changed constraint and the report's attempt status; do not request approvals or credentials.
